title: Trump thanks supporters for the memories in final campaign stops for 2026 midterms
summary: President Trump has maintained a near-daily rally schedule as Election Day draws closer, playing his greatest hits for loyal crowds in red states in what is a sort-of goodbye to campaigning.
contentText:
